Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

place — an area or location. Example: It is a beautiful place.
view — what you can see from a place. Example: The view is amazing.
mountain — a very high hill. Example: The village is in the mountains.
sea — the salt water near the coast. Example: The sea is near the village.
city — a large town. Example: The city is busy.
beautiful — very pleasant to look at. Example: It is a beautiful place.
amazing — very surprising and good. Example: The view is amazing.
ever — at any time in your life. Example: Have you ever been there?
never — not at any time. Example: I have never seen it.
travel — to go from one place to another. Example: I love to travel.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• The best place I have ever seen ...
• Have you ever been to ...?
• I have never seen ...
• The view is amazing.
• It is a beautiful place.

Grammar focus: Present perfect: have ever seen.
Use the present perfect with ever and never for life experience: Have you ever been to the mountains? I have never seen it. Use the best place I have ever seen for the top of your experience.
